Wrongfully convicted of a crime he did not commit, a quiet and methodical banker is sentenced to life in a notoriously brutal maximum-security prison. Amidst decades of despair, brutality, and institutional corruption, he forms an unlikely friendship with a seasoned contraband smuggler. Through unwavering patience, quiet resilience, and a brilliant, hidden long-term plan, he quietly chips away at his confinement toward the ultimate taste of freedom.
